# Shoonya Zomerstage 2027

> Zomerstage is Shoonya Dance Centre's annual dance and yoga retreat in the South of France. The 2027 edition runs 3–9 July 2027: six nights and five full class days at a resort near Mont Ventoux, reserved for participants. Registration opens October 2026.

## Key facts
- Dates: 3–9 July 2027 — arrive Saturday 3 July, leave Friday 9 July; six nights, five full class days.
- Location: a peaceful village in the South of France, near Mont Ventoux and Provençal towns such as Lourmarin and Bonnieux. The entire resort is reserved for participants.
- Format: dance and yoga classes in the mornings and late evenings; free afternoons; 95+ hours of classes offered across the week. A theme night and parties every evening.
- Included: six-night stay, three organic and locally sourced meals a day plus an afternoon snack, and all the dance and yoga classes you choose.
- Meals: all meals are vegetarian, with the option to eat non-vegetarian at dinner (chosen at registration; non-vegetarian diners are seated at their own table at dinner).
- Not included: transport to the resort, drinks.
- Level: speed courses for first-time dancers and advanced courses for dancers with more experience.
- Organiser: Shoonya Dance Centre, a non-profit dance & culture organisation based in Ghent, Belgium.

## Prices (per person)

Prices include six nights, all meals and every class a participant chooses. Transport and drinks are separate.
- Sleeping loft (max. 15 people): €670
- 4-person room: €895
- 3-person room: €950
- 2-person room: €980
- Single room: €1,095

## Registration & payment
- Registration opens October 2026. Subscribe to the newsletter to be notified: https://www.shoonyadance.com/newsletter
- A €150 deposit per person secures a spot, due within 8 days of registering.
- A second instalment of €250 is due by 15 January 2027; the remaining balance is requested closer to the retreat.
- Cancellation (per participant): before 1 January 2027 → €250; before 1 March 2027 → €500; after 1 March 2027 → full amount.
